column2: On top as tabs, in a side column, on a spinning wheel, Systems (a big carousel), Folders (each console as a folder with its covers peeking out) or Records (each console is a vinyl in its sleeve, and the chosen one slides out its spinning disc). In Systems, Folders and Records you pick the console first and then enter its games.

Em Sistemas, Pastas e Discos você escolhe o console primeiro e depois entra nos jogos.
